We can respond with a disclaimer that we cannot fetch live data. But maybe we can approximate or say we can't provide real-time. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we should say we don't have real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or market websites. Also we can mention typical price ranges. But we should not provide inaccurate numbers. So we should respond with a disclaimer.
